subject.title: fix(copilot): bound BYOK proxy request bodies

question: Should `openclaw/plugin-sdk/webhook-ingress` publicly expose caller-owned teardown through `destroyOnError`, or should Copilot use a narrower response-aware helper without expanding the SDK option surface?
rationale: Both shapes can fix the bug, but the chosen public plugin contract and its cleanup responsibility require owner intent rather than automated inference.

options.title: Keep the optional SDK flag
options.body: Retain the backward-compatible option, document and test caller-owned cleanup, and fix Copilot teardown to wait for response completion.

options.title: Use a narrower helper
options.body: Avoid the general SDK option and provide a response-aware or Copilot-local seam that owns safe error delivery and teardown together.

recommendation.title: Keep the optional SDK flag
recommendation.body: Retain the backward-compatible option, document and test caller-owned cleanup, and fix Copilot teardown to wait for response completion.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision belongs to the owners of the Copilot harness and webhook-ingress plugin SDK contract, whose individual provenance was not recoverable from the available history evidence.
